newsitem.title: USA: Miami workers find James Stewart movie treasure.
newsitem.headline: Miami workers find James Stewart movie treasure.

text.p: Construction workers tearing up a street in Miami Beach have unearthed a time capsule buried by actor James Stewart to mark the premier of "The Glenn Miller Story" 43 years ago.

Among the movie memorabilia the steel tube contained were the film's screenplay, congratulatory messages from actors Alec Guiness, Laurence Olivier and Douglas Fairbanks Jr, a roll of footage and a 1954 magazine reviewing the film, city officials said on Saturday.
It also held a brown jug and a string of pearls that Stewart, playing Miller, gave to his wife in the film in honour of two of the bandleader's hits.
The cinema where the world premiere of "The Glenn Miller Story" was held was demolished years ago. City spokeswoman Nannette Rodriguez said Stewart himself buried the capsule as a publicity stunt.
Miller died in December 1944 during the Second World War when his plane disappeared over the English Channel.
